chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ibn Faddal, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (referring to Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.اَلشُّقْرَةِ: Al-Shuqrat (a specific valley or place name)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying in Wadi al-Shuqrat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on valid and invalid places for prayer, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifically prohibits praying in Wadi al-Shuqrat. While the exact geographical identity of this valley is subject to scholarly discussion, the ruling highlights the principle that certain locations may be deemed makruh or haram due to specific environmental characteristics or historical traditions, emphasizing the importance of selecting a dignified and pure space for worship.
